messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: service-discovery-prod — SRV lookup error rate >15% (us-east-1a). Pager sent to @derek-oncall and @alice.sre.

alice.sre: seeing the page, jumping in. any customer-facing symptoms?

eva-support: support queue shows a spike of 503s for inference endpoints pinned to us-east-1a. A few customers reporting timeouts.

ben.prodeng: running quick check — querying internal SRV for model-router in us-east-1a returns SERVFAIL intermittently.

carla-netops: confirmed from control-plane: some CoreDNS pods in us-east-1a are returning SERVFAIL for cluster SRV lookups. Other AZs ok.

alice.sre: can someone paste a failing dig?

ben.prodeng: sure:
```
$ dig +short SRV _model-router._tcp.prod.svc.cluster.local @10.0.5.12
; -> SERVFAIL
```

alice.sre: thanks. checking CoreDNS logs now. seeing repeated "read udp: i/o timeout" and "lookup failed: context deadline exceeded" to our Consul backend in same AZ.

jordan-plat: looks like Consul agent in us-east-1a is flapping — rpc connections to the local server are timing out. networking shows TCP retransmits to the Consul controller set.

carla-netops: checking VPC flow logs — inter-instance routing inside us-east-1a has elevated retransmits, possibly due to bad NIC firmware on a host we rolled out last night. rolling back the firmware change on the few hosts that reported errors.

alice.sre: temporary mitigation — can we restart CoreDNS pods in the affected node pools to re-resolve to healthy Consul endpoints?

jordan-plat: yes, doing a rolling restart of coredns daemonset in us-east-1a with maxUnavailable=1.

ops-bot: deploy started: rolling restart coredns/us-east-1a (initiated by jordan-plat).

ben.prodeng: after the first restart, SRV lookups recover on that node. running health check across replicas. still seeing flapping on two nodes.

carla-netops: rollback of NIC firmware confirmed on 3 hosts ~ +7m. network retransmits dropping. Consul agents reestablished cluster connectivity.

alice.sre: observed customer impact window: 1763209800 -> 1763210920 (~18 minutes) where model-router SRV resolution failed for clients pinned to us-east-1a. ETA to full recovery?

jordan-plat: DNS resolution stabilized across all nodes ~ 1763210950 after restarts and host rollback.

eva-support: recording affected customers for post-incident contact: 4 active tenants saw increased errors (IDs redacted). We'll open support escalations.

alice.sre: mitigation summary: 1) rolled back NIC firmware on affected hosts; 2) rolling restart of CoreDNS replicas in us-east-1a; 3) promoted standby Consul server in us-east-1b to reduce cross-AZ reliance for clients in a future emergency.

derek-oncall: taking over oncall for follow-ups. i'll create an incident ticket and own the postmortem. what's the immediate action item list?

alice.sre: assignable follow-ups:
- carla-netops: run full health sweep for NIC firmware versions across all regions and block the bad firmware from future deploys.
- jordan-plat: add extra Consul agents to us-east-1a to reduce dependence on single hosts and add alerting for elevated UDP/TCP retransmits between agents.
- ben.prodeng: add SRV lookup rate and SERVFAIL anomaly alerting with a lower threshold.
- eva-support: contact affected customers with timeline and mitigation.

derek-oncall: noted. creating INC-17632 and linking this thread. Handoff: i'll be primary oncall for the postmortem and remediation until 1763280000.

ops-bot: INC-17632 created: "us-east-1a SRV resolution partial outage" — assigned to derek-oncall.

alice.sre: rough impact metrics: peak error rate +2.4% of total requests across that AZ, 99.9th latency increased by ~350ms for routed requests, 4 tenants experienced >1% error spikes.

eva-support: added customer notes and ticket numbers to the incident doc.

carla-netops: we also observed a small number of ETCD/kv timeouts in control plane logs correlated with the same window — likely noisy network. will include in root cause draft.

derek-oncall: thanks everyone. i'll schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow. if anyone has logs or traces to add, append to INC-17632.

alice.sre: closing the page for active mitigation. still on watch for 1h. marking this thread as resolved->monitoring. :white_check_mark:
